company.shortDescription: Al Taamir Mortgage Finance - Al Oula is a Al-Tameer Real Estate Finance Company.
company.description: Al Tameer Mortgage Finance - Al Oula - is the largest mortgage finance company in the Arab Republic of Egypt. Al Oula is recognized as the market leader in adopting best practices regarding Egyptian Financial Services, and creating tremendous opportunities in mortgage sector.

productsAndServices.description: Provides financing for individuals and companies to own residential, administrative, commercial, service, or medical units with loans up to 300 million EGP and repayment terms up to 10 years.
productsAndServices.name: Tammouk (Ownership Financing)

productsAndServices.description: Offers liquidity financing up to 300 million EGP on any owned residential, administrative, commercial, service, or medical unit with repayment terms up to 10 years.
productsAndServices.name: Wafra (Liquidity Financing)

productsAndServices.description: Enables real estate developers to obtain liquidity by transferring rights of their real estate portfolios to Al Taamir for financing purposes.
productsAndServices.name: Mahafiz (Portfolio Financing for Developers)

productsAndServices.description: Supports low- and middle-income individuals through financing programs aligned with the Central Bank of Egypt's housing finance initiatives.
productsAndServices.name: Central Bank Initiative Financing

productsAndServices.description: Provides property valuation services to determine the fair market value of real estate units during financing application processes.
productsAndServices.name: Real Estate Appraisal Service

productsAndServices.description: Evaluates clients' credit reports (I-Score) to assess creditworthiness during mortgage financing applications.
productsAndServices.name: I-Score Credit Report Analysis
